options: Only url, max_bytes, timeout_ms. GET only; no request body, headers, paths or credentials.
destination: One firmware-owned download object per full app directory, outside app/read_file/write_file namespaces. Two generations, max 4194344 bytes including metadata; no import or overwrite of old saves.
completion: on_http{id,status,kind='download',size=N} only after commit, or {id,status,kind='download',error=CODE}. Never body or filesystem paths. Only HTTP 200 commits.
read: smudge.download_read(offset,count) -> binary_string,total_size OR nil,error. Explicit zero-based absolute seek each call; integer count 1..1024, offset 0..2097152; EOF empty string; beyond EOF invalid_offset. No Lua/native persistent reader handle. Busy while any HTTP job owns slot.
lifecycle: Same global slot, main-thread dispatch and http_cancel(id) as API3. Cancellation observed before promotion aborts; successful promotion wins later cancellation. Shutdown detaches Lua; native job owns root until drainage.
security: API3 domain grant, public DNS binding, trusted UTC, X509 chain/hostname/time, HTTPS443, no redirects/compression/credential headers unchanged. min_api>=4 required for new calls. Simulator fails closed.
storage: Private fixed part/0/1 names; sync and close before rename to vacant generation. Failure preserves previous generation. Physical FAT corruption/power-loss atomicity not guaranteed; SD removal may prevent immediate part cleanup, retried at next download.
memory: Reuse existing 8192-byte native result buffer as at most 1024-byte transfer scratch; never whole archive in Lua. Read buffer 1024 native bytes owned by session.
publication: local follow-up only; no API3 feature claim; device/independent review required before integration
activation: BLOCKED: no production atomic-failure filesystem backend; https_download_file false on hardware and simulator. Portable core and native backend tests implemented.
